Reusing a general writing or claim-audit asset does not alone create distinctness; the procedure output and original step/exception package do.

fictional_worked_example.label: Original synthetic scenario brief; not an executed model or real team procedure.
fictional_worked_example.task: Prepare the approved orientation handout packet from a supplied approved-file list.

source_notes.N1: The coordinator supplies the current approved-file list and a destination packet folder.
source_notes.N2: The assistant copies only listed files into that supplied folder; source files remain untouched.
source_notes.N3: Before handoff, the assistant compares filenames and revision dates with the approved list.
source_notes.N4: If a listed file is missing or its revision differs, stop and ask the coordinator; do not substitute another version.
source_notes.N5: After checks, send the packet location to the coordinator, who handles distribution. Folder naming and retention policy have not been supplied.

fictional_worked_example.expected_shape: Five bounded steps: obtain list and folder; check source availability and revisions; copy matching listed files; compare packet with list; provide location for coordinator review. Preserve N4 as a blocking exception. No public sharing or real file operation occurs in this example.
fictional_worked_example.error_to_catch: An author-written faulty draft invents automatic approval and a seven-day retention policy. Claim audit must flag their unsupported factual implications; human removes them and keeps approval/retention unresolved.
fictional_worked_example.human_walkthrough: Manually map every step and exception to N1–N5, walk the successful and missing-file paths on paper, and record whether the reader can identify input, role, result and stop condition. Do not call this a real operational test or an AI result.
fictional_worked_example.expected_result: Editable draft procedure and source/exception map; the coordinator review remains pending, and no retention duration or authorization is invented.

author_requirements.reader_delivery: Put a copyable original blank template near the beginning. Offer Markdown/plain text downloads; explain how to paste into a document editor. Do not target Word/PDF-download variants without creating and checking those formats.
author_requirements.differentiation: Source-to-step mapping, a missing-file branch and a documented human walkthrough connect the two assets. General SOP definitions or two generic writing links alone are insufficient.
